g.text: Offline capture and synchronisation (sequence, UC-02, FR-03)
save a patient or a screening
straight after sign-in, when the connection returns, when the app comes back
to the foreground, every 5 minutes, or when "Sync now" is tapped
store the result under the key
REJECTED: keep with the reason, "Needs attention"
patients and records of the facility,
wait 2 s, 4 s, 8 s ... (max 15 min, jitter),
or longer if the server says Retry-After
